mechanics.claim: Scoring a takedown against a hunted target grants a permanent stack of Mark of the Kindred, which powers up Kindred's other abilities.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

mechanics.claim: Lamb gains bonus range on basic attacks and Mounting Dread (E) based on stack count, not damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''.
